svg.text: Enhanced plan: four deployables in Stage 1, ten services in the code
Each module keeps its own schema, contract and outbox. The deployment composes them; a split later is a chart change.
SHARED PLATFORM, ONE REGION IN INDIA
workers, reviewers, candidates, ops on mobile
a module imports only packages/*; its own database role; events out through its
outbox, even to a sibling; one migration job per module
earnings, pay windows, holds, cost ledger, rail
adapters; its own release train and deploy freeze
directories with a contract and a health endpoint; not
odoo: deployable 4, the system of record
worker record, bench, accounting, vendor bills with TDS, client invoices; the Assessment v2
one schema and one role per module,
